csv_scope_of_work: The Bartow Municipal Airport Authority is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified Design-Build Contractors to provide complete design, permitting, and construction services for a new pre-engineered metal warehouse facility at the Bartow Executive Airport. This procurement is being conducted as a Design-Build project. The selected Contractor shall be responsible for providing all professional architectural and engineering services, permitting, materials, labor, supervision, equipment, and incidentals necessary to deliver a complete, fully operational facility.
